title: Page 8
content_zh:
时间会让她逐渐安定，逐渐笃定。

暮春四月底，原平之率领大队人马浩浩荡荡地奔赴幽州。

金陵到蓟城这一路并不算太难行，前半段路沿着大运河的路线乘船，庞大的船只非常平稳，而南方人士亦多识水性，不会晕船，所以平安无事；倒是在海津镇下船转乘陆路马车之后，土路的颠簸让许多娇生惯养之辈难以适应。

而顾惜恩也很不适应，多年的征战让北方处处荒芜，连官道也因为缺少修缮而起伏不平，再加上天气燥热起来，北方又干燥，快到蓟城时，顾惜恩开始不舒服了。她先是浑身虚弱，后来小腹疼痛，一开始她以为是月事来了，而且也确实见红了，可是后来算算日子根本不对！

之前因为原平之返回金陵，惊喜纷扰后又马上准备北行，各种忙碌中，顾惜恩忽略了自己的月事并没有按时来到，那时已经延迟了半个多月了。

当她的小腹疼痛越来越严重，已经无法忍耐时，她才偷偷告诉了自己的陪嫁嬷嬷。陪嫁嬷嬷立时大惊，当嬷嬷问清楚了顾惜恩的情况后，更是担心——她家小姐可能流产了。

谁也没想到顾惜恩会这么快怀孕，她真的年纪还太小。

原平之自己也特地吩咐过嬷嬷和大丫鬟，在顾惜恩沐浴时加入有助避孕的一些药材，他也担心妻子年纪太小便怀孕，有害身体。

可是千防万防总还是没防住，顾惜恩真的怀孕了，而且因为路途颠簸劳累流产了。

跟随北行队伍的太医也没能救回原平之和顾惜恩的第一个孩子。

顾惜恩整个人都傻了，甚至连身体的痛楚都感受不到了。

她的宝宝没有了？！

她怎么会没注意到自己月事的异常？她怎么会没考虑过夫妻圆房之后就有可能怀上小娃娃？

她口口声声说要为夫君生娃娃，可是她怎么就这么不经心？

都是她的错！

身为一个母亲，她居然不知道宝宝已经在她的肚子里，她怎么可以如此粗心大意？

顾惜恩难受得几乎无法承受，在原平之的怀抱中泪流不止。

「别哭了，太医说了，这个时候要小心自己的身体，小月子也是月子，这时候哭泣对眼睛不好。」原平之也难过，可是他更在意顾惜恩，她真的年纪太小了，这个年纪无论怀孕还是流产都是极大的折磨。

说起来还是他的错，如果他不那么心急与她圆房，如果他能再耐心等待两年，等一切水到渠成，瓜熟蒂落，就不会对她造成伤害了。

顾惜恩啜泣着，埋首在原平之的怀中，哭道：「都是我的错，都是我，我不是个好母亲，呜……呜呜……」

她已经这样哭泣了好久，原平之真怕她哭坏了眼睛，他叹口气，低声对她说：「快别难过了，如果不是一路颠簸也不会出事，而且宝宝也绝对不愿意让母亲伤心，不然他会不安心的，知道吗？」

顾惜恩的哭泣果然压抑住了一些。

原平之继续安慰她：「我听老人家们说过，宝宝未成形之前如果去了，父母若真心思念，宝宝还会再回来的。」

「真的？」顾惜恩抬起红红的眼睛问。

原平之点头，说：「你要好好调养身体，这次要把自己养得健健康康的，然后我们再要孩子，到时候宝宝一定会回来的。」

顾惜恩点点头，握紧了原平之的手，她努力想让自己振作，可是热泪还是忍不住洒在了两人紧握的手上。

第10章(1)

五年后。

景国 幽州 燕京。

如今的燕京就是以前的蓟城，三年前皇帝玄昱亲自赐名燕京，作为景国的新京城。

如今的燕京是一个盛况空前的大工地，直接、间接的劳动力超过十万人，日以继夜地辛勤劳作，就为了建造一个宏伟壮丽的新都城。

五年的时间，仅仅够原平之将燕京圈划出一个大框架，外城、内城、皇城、紫禁城，由外向内层层包围，将紫禁城拱卫在都城最中心的位置。

紫禁城为宫城，是皇宫禁地，也是整个都城的中心，处于城市东西中轴线上，形势恢弘，气魄宏伟，较金陵皇宫更为壮丽。

现在原平之工作的重点就是建造紫禁城，以及紫禁城和皇城的各个城门。

再过两年，皇帝玄昱就准备迁都了，最起码要先将他居住的地方建造好。

玄昱是个急性子的皇帝，他不想等到自己白发苍苍的时候再迁都，所以他直接吩咐原平之加速工程进度，替他先盖好几间屋子，让他有个睡觉的地方就行了。

皇帝说得简单，可是手下人又怎敢真的随便给他两间屋？怎么也要盖得富丽堂皇，能够更加展现新京城新气象才好吧？

所以原平之累得很。

昔日养尊处优的纨裤子弟，如今变成了工作狂人，一日十二个时辰恨不得工作十个时辰。

偌大的工地处处有问题，虽然他已经极力将权力下放，但是完美主义的性格让他很难真正放心，难免就要面面俱到、事必躬亲，再加上经常在工地奔波，他如今整个人累得又黑又瘦，每每让顾惜恩亲自伺候他沐浴的时候都难受得不行。

万幸的是，顾惜恩每天都紧盯着他按时吃饭，精心为他调配营养，他虽然又黑又瘦，身体却不虚弱，反而结实了许多，精神也一直很好。

每每顾惜恩担心他时，原平之却笑着说：「刚成亲时，你让我去忙，我都不知道该忙些什么，每日遛鸟斗鸡的，觉得日子可真漫长，一日一日过得很慢很慢。现在却好，一年一年都觉得时光飞逝，好像还没做出些事情，时间就过去了。」

显然，他喜欢这种忙碌，忙碌充实的日子让他不再觉得年华虚度，让他不再总是懒洋洋的，让他有了更多的自信和成就感。

以前，他觉得做个纨裤米虫没什么不好，可日子总过得轻飘飘的，好像无法落地的鸟儿，即使没做事也有种虚虚的疲倦。

现在，他终于双脚踏在了坚实的土地上，日日辛苦奔忙着。累，却不倦，他的心里充满了快乐。

这五年时间过得飞快，于国于家都发生了许多大事，其中最重大的莫过于「皇长子事件」。

两年前，玄昱派人将十三岁的原琅接回了金陵，并且让原琅认祖归宗，名为玄渊，皇子中排行最长，是为震惊景国朝野的「皇长子事件」。

原平之本人也很震惊，他实在无法理解自己乖乖的庶出侄子怎么摇身一变就成了皇子？

玄昱再荒唐，也不应该和自己臣子兼表兄的妾勾搭通奸吧？如果是真的，那也太荒唐了吧？玄昱这个混蛋的节操还有下限吗？

原平之愤怒得几乎当时就想撂下手中的工作，亲自返回金陵去质问玄昱和原修之：人要脸，树要皮，你们的脸皮呢？

顾惜恩劝阻了他，要他以国事为重，毕竟建设京城之事非同儿戏，岂可说放手就放手？

后来，原家的嫡长子原修之亲自给弟弟来了封密函，详细解释了当年那档子阴错阳差的乌龙事，最后安慰他：皇上毕竟是皇上，虽然他真的很过分，那也藏在心里装不知道吧，咱们得罪不起啊。

原平之拿着这信哭笑不得，他第一次知道自家长兄原来也很幽默。

气过怒过后，原平之也只能无奈。遇到玄昱这样一个皇帝，真不知道是普天下臣民的幸或者不幸。

除此之外，另外一件让原平之烦心的，是这五年来顾惜恩一直没有再怀孕。
content_en:
Time will make her gradually settle down and become more confident.

At the end of April in late spring, Yuan Pingzhi led a large group of troops to Youzhou.

The journey from Jinling to Jicheng was not too difficult. The first half of the journey was by boat along the route of the Grand Canal. The huge boat was very stable, and people from the south were more familiar with water and would not get seasick, so it was uneventful. However, after getting off the boat in Haijin Town and transferring to a land carriage, the bumpy dirt road made it difficult for many pampered people to adapt.

Gu Xi'en was also very uncomfortable with it. Years of war had left the north desolate, and even the official roads were uneven due to lack of repairs. In addition, the weather was getting hotter and the north was dry. As they approached Jicheng, Gu Xi'en began to feel uncomfortable.She felt weak at first, and then had pain in her lower abdomen. At first she thought it was menstruation, and she did get red, but then she calculated the date and it was wrong!

Because of Yuan Pingzhi's return to Jinling, he was immediately preparing to go north after being surprised. In all the busyness, Gu Xien neglected that her menstrual period did not arrive on time. It had been delayed for more than half a month.

When the pain in her lower abdomen became more and more severe and became unbearable, she secretly told her dowry.The dowry mama was immediately shocked. When she asked about Gu Xien's situation, she became even more worried - her young lady might have had a miscarriage.

No one expected that Gu Xien would become pregnant so soon. She was really too young.

Yuan Pingzhi himself had specifically ordered his nanny and maid to add some medicinal materials that could help with contraception when Gu Xi'en bathed. He was also worried that his wife would become pregnant if she was too young, which would be harmful to her health.

But despite all the precautions, Gu Xien was really pregnant and had a miscarriage due to fatigue on the bumpy road.

The imperial doctor who followed the northbound team also failed to save Yuan Pingzhi and Gu Xien's first child.

Gu Xien was completely stunned and couldn't even feel the pain in her body.

Her baby is gone?!

How could she not notice the abnormality of her menstruation?How could she not have considered the possibility of conceiving a baby after the couple consummated their marriage?

She kept saying that she wanted to have a baby for her husband, but why was she so careless?

It's all her fault!

As a mother, she didn't know that the baby was already in her belly. How could she be so careless?

Gu Xi'en was so uncomfortable that she could hardly bear it, and she couldn't stop crying in Yuan Pingzhi's arms.

"Stop crying, the imperial doctor said, you should be careful with your body at this time. Confinement is also confinement, and crying at this time is not good for the eyes." Yuan Pingzhi was also sad, but he was more concerned about Gu Xien. She was really too young. Pregnancy or miscarriage at this age would be a great torture.

It was still his fault. If he had not been so anxious to consummate her marriage, if he could have waited patiently for another two years, and waited for everything to fall into place, he would not have caused any harm to her.

Gu Xien sobbed, buried her head in Yuan Pingzhi's arms, and cried: "It's all my fault, it's all me, I'm not a good mother, wu... wu wu..."

She had been crying like this for a long time. Yuan Pingzhen was really afraid that she would hurt her eyes from crying. He sighed and whispered to her: "Don't be sad now. If it hadn't been a bumpy road, nothing would have happened. And the baby would never want to make his mother sad, otherwise he would be uneasy, you know?"

Gu Xien's crying was indeed suppressed.

Yuan Pingzhi continued to comfort her: "I heard the elders say that if the baby goes before it is formed, if the parents really miss him, the baby will come back."

"Really?" Gu Xien raised her red eyes and asked.

Yuan Pingzhi nodded and said, "You have to take good care of your body and make yourself healthy this time. Then we will have a baby. The baby will definitely come back by then."

Gu Xien nodded and held Yuan Pingzhi's hand tightly. She tried hard to cheer herself up, but she couldn't help but shed tears on their clasped hands.

Chapter 10(1)

Five years later.

Jingguo Youzhou Yanjing.

Today's Yanjing is the former Jicheng. Emperor Xuanyu personally named Yanjing three years ago as the new capital of Jingguo.

Today's Yanjing is a large construction site with unprecedented grandeur, with more than 100,000 direct and indirect laborers working hard day and night to build a magnificent new capital.

Five years was only enough time for Yuan Pingzhi to draw a large framework for the Yanjing Circle. The outer city, inner city, imperial city, and Forbidden City were surrounded from the outside to the inside, and the Forbidden City was guarded in the center of the capital.

The Forbidden City is a palace city, a forbidden area for the imperial palace, and the center of the entire capital. It is located on the east-west central axis of the city. It has a magnificent situation and a grand spirit, and is more magnificent than the Jinling Palace.

Now the focus of Yuan Pingzhi's work is to build the Forbidden City, as well as the various gates of the Forbidden City and the Imperial City.

In two years' time, Emperor Xuan Yu will be ready to move the capital. At least the place where he lives must be built first.

Xuan Yu was an impatient emperor. He didn't want to wait until he was gray-haired before moving the capital, so he directly ordered Yuan Pingzhi to speed up the progress of the project and build several houses for him first so that he could have a place to sleep.

The emperor made it simple, but how could his subordinates really dare to give him two rooms?Why should it be built magnificently, so that it can better show the new atmosphere of the new capital?

So Yuan Pingzhi was very tired.

The former pampered playboy has now become a workaholic. He can't wait to work ten hours out of twelve hours a day.

There were problems everywhere in the huge construction site. Although he had tried his best to decentralize power, his perfectionist personality made it difficult for him to truly rest assured. He would inevitably have to do everything by hand. In addition, he often rushed around the construction site. He was now tired, dark and thin, and he felt extremely uncomfortable every time Gu Xien personally took care of him to bathe.

Fortunately, Gu Xien watched him eat on time every day and carefully prepared nutrition for him. Although he was dark and thin, his body was not weak, but he was much stronger and his spirit was always good.

Whenever Gu Xi'en was worried about him, Yuan Pingzhi said with a smile: "When we first got married, you asked me to be busy. I didn't know what to do. I walked the birds and fought the cocks every day. I felt that the days were really long, and each day passed very slowly. But now, it's better. Year by year, I feel that time flies by. It seems that time has passed before I have done anything."

Obviously, he likes this kind of busyness. The busy and fulfilling days make him no longer feel that his years are wasted, make him no longer always lazy, and give him more confidence and sense of accomplishment.

In the past, he felt that there was nothing wrong with being a dandy, but his days were always light, like a bird that couldn't land, and he felt tired even if he didn't do anything.

Now, he finally has his feet on solid ground and is working hard every day.Tired, but not tired, his heart was full of happiness.

The past five years have passed very quickly, and many major events have happened in the country and the family, the most important of which is the "Emperor's Eldest Son Incident".

Two years ago, Xuan Yu sent someone to bring the 13-year-old Yuan Lang back to Jinling, and asked Yuan Lang to recognize his ancestor and return him to the clan. He was named Xuanyuan, the oldest among the princes. This was because of the "Emperor's Eldest Son Incident" that shocked the Jingguo court and everyone.

Yuan Pingzhi himself was also shocked. He really couldn't understand how his obedient concubine nephew suddenly became a prince?

No matter how ridiculous Xuan Yu was, he shouldn't have committed adultery with his courtier and cousin's concubine, right?If it's true, that's ridiculous, right?Is there any lower limit to the moral integrity of this bastard Xuan Yu?

Yuan Pingzhi was so angry that he almost wanted to put down his work and return to Jinling in person to question Xuan Yu and Yuan Xiuzhi: People want face, trees want bark, where is your face?

Gu Xien dissuaded him and asked him to put national affairs first. After all, the construction of the capital was not a piece of cake. How could he just let it go?

Later, the eldest son of the Yuan family, Yuan Xiuzhi, personally sent a sealed letter to his younger brother, explaining in detail the erroneous things that happened at that stall, and finally comforted him: The emperor is the emperor after all, and although he is really too much, just hide it in your heart and pretend not to know, we can't afford to offend him.

Yuan Pingzhi didn't know whether to laugh or cry while holding this letter. For the first time, he knew that his elder brother was also very humorous.

After getting angry, Yuan Pingzhi had no choice but to do it.I don't know whether it is the blessing or misfortune of all the people in the world to meet an emperor like Xuan Yu.

In addition, another thing that bothered Yuan Pingzhi was that Gu Xien had not been pregnant again in the past five years.
